what: name-verified unload of the reviewer's own spot modules
true_cause: the spot harness's own `run()` helper truncates subprocess stdout to 200-800 chars; `pactl list modules short` is ~2.4 kB (43 modules), so the harness's verification line (and the residue census) never saw its own sink_name= row and the unload silently no-op'd. NOT a pactl reader failure — corrected after the volume spot reproduced it.
verification: each unload re-read the module table and fired only the index whose arg carried sink_name=r87r_<own name>; every spot object was r87r_<pid>-named; no r87a_/foreign object touched; no set-default-*
